name: Tetrazene
description: Tetrazene (CAS 54410-57-0 ), also referenced in some technical catalogues as Tetraaz-1-ene, is a high-nitrogen heterocyclic compound used as a sensitizer and polymerization initiator in energetic material formulations. Its primary commercial role is in primer and ignition compositions where reliable, low-energy initiation is required. In defense and aerospace propulsion, it is incorporated into percussion primer mixes. This chemical serves to lower the activation threshold of primary explosive compositions. Mining and blasting operations use it in detonator and initiator assemblies where consistent sensitivity is critical. It functions as a co-sensitizer alongside lead styphnate or diazodinitrophenol in small-arms and pyrotechnic primer formulations. Research programs evaluate it as a candidate to replace legacy heavy-metal compounds. The material is supplied as a dry powder, typically handled and shipped in desensitized or wetted form to meet transport regulations. Material is generally offered to technical-grade specifications. Purity and particle size characterization are provided on a lot-specific basis.
